greeting.text: Oh, 302. You must be really busy lately~

lines.text: I hardly ever see you. Lots of work?
About the braised beef… never mind, it's fine. Busy people get busy.
Still, make sure you eat. That's what matters most.

flushRemark.text: Oh, are you okay? Maybe I shouldn't have asked.

closers.endured: I kept you again. Go on in.
